raw_output.raw_text: <search query="中国 房地产税 地方政府 财政收入 占比 2022 2023" search_time="2026年5月19日11时35分星期二"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:1"><title>新时代房地产税改革：纳税能力、税负分布与收入规模</title><summary>房地产税改革是当前我国财税体制改革中的焦点、重点与难点。党的二十大报告提出“规范收入分配秩序，规范财富积累机制”，标志着我国分配制度建设步入了收入流量和财富存量调节并重的新征程。在高质量发展中促进共同富裕，要求作为存量调节的现代房地产税发挥更广泛的职能作用。基于中国家庭追踪调查（cfps）数据，通过实证分析房地产税的纳税能力、税负分布与收入规模，研究发现：不同地区的纳税能力和可行税率差别较大；从税负分布的角度来看，随着扣除面积和扣除价值的增加，家庭房地产税负分布体现了更强的累进性；经测算，在不同税收优惠和税率形式下我国房地产税的收入规模，再结合国际经验来看，未来房地产税的筹资能力较为有限。因此，建议分省确定计税依据和税率，彰显量能课税原则；兼顾不同收入群体的实际情况，确定免税和扣除方案；基于房地产税的筹资能力，审慎做好改革实施的顶层设计。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>当代财经</publisher><author_list><author name="王越" affiliation="清华大学 社会科学学院" /><author name="郝晓婧" affiliation="中国财政科学研究院" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7110151007</url><publish_time>2023年7月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:2"><title>中国城镇住宅房地产税合意税率设计研究</title><summary>本文在满足政府财力需求和实现居民合理税负两个现实条件约束下,设计中国城镇住宅房地产税改革的税率,并研究各省市的税率合意区间。定量研究发现:第一,人均免征面积在 35 平方米时,房地产税的全国平均合意税率区间为 0.66%-1.77%;第二,房地产税率属地化特性明显,呈现东部-中部-西部-东北逐步递增趋势;第三,改革初期房地产税的财政职能仅能定位为一般税种,在人均免征面积 35 平方米的合意税率区间可提升地方政府财力 2.11%-7.50%。政策建议包括:开征初期实行地区差别化比例税率,充分给予地方政府一定的税率自主权;房地产税税种的地域属性差异会加大地区间税收收入差距,需要进一步强化中央政府的转移支付作用。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>税制改革</publisher><author_list><author name="张帅" affiliation="1.北京大学汇丰商学院,深圳 518055;2.中央财经大学,北京 102206;3.北京市朝阳区人民政府亚运村街道办事处,北京 102026" /><author name="童健" affiliation="1.北京大学汇丰商学院,深圳 518055;2.中央财经大学,北京 102206;3.北京市朝阳区人民政府亚运村街道办事处,北京 102026" /><author name="董雪" affiliation="1.北京大学汇丰商学院,深圳 518055;2.中央财经大学,北京 102206;3.北京市朝阳区人民政府亚运村街道办事处,北京 102026" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7109202549</url></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:3"><title>Housing Property Tax Reform</title><summary>Since the 19th National Congress, the improvement and promotion of property tax legislation have become one of the core contents of the tax reform. As a property tax, property tax is also a stock tax; unlike flow taxes, it will inevitably affect residents' willingness to consume. With the impact of the reform of the “business tax changed to VAT” on local fiscal revenue, and the slowdown in economic growth and downward pressure have become the primary problems facing local governments, the introduction of property tax not only contributes to the construction of local tax systems but also gradually increase the proportion of direct taxes. As far as the domestic situation is concerned, it is not necessary to clarify the legislative purpose and functional orientation of the property tax. It is clear that the property tax should be based on the adjustment of income distribution as a core function, taking into account the tasks of raising fiscal revenue, promote social equity, clearly regulating the boundaries of functions, and adjusting the collection scope of the property tax. June 2024</publisher><url>http://n2.sinaimg.cn/finance/efc75865/20240614/CEU-June-2024-EN.pdf</url><publish_time>2024年6月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:13"><title>土地市场降温与地方政府债务风险：来自区县级数据的证据</title><summary>摘要:土地市场持续降温会引发土地财政格局发生改变,进而波及地方政府债务风险,使之不同于以往。本文基于中国区县级数据,构建强度双重差分模型检验了土地市场降温对地方政府债务风险的影响。研究发现:土地市场降温导致地方政府债务风险上升,其内在逻辑在于,土地市场降温导致土地流拍增加、土地出让收入下降,进而通过财力渠道引致地方政府债务风险上升。为应对债务压力,地方政府偏好发行长期债券并增加借新还旧比重,这进一步加剧了地方政府债务风险的累积。异质性分析发现,城投债存量较高的地方政府更容易受到土地市场降温的负面冲击,而财政收入质量较高的地方政府则能够较好地抵御上述风险。本文系统分析了土地市场降温背景下的地方政府债务风险变化及机制,为缓解地方财政压力、防范化解地方政府债务风险提供了实证证据及政策参考。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>数量经济技术经济研究2024年第7期</publisher><author_list><author name="周佳音" affiliation="东北财经大学经济学院" /><author name="陆毅" affiliation="清华大学经济管理学院" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7112509158</url><publish_time>2024年7月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:14"><title>GLOBAL FINANCIAL STABILITY REPORT: THE LAST MILE: FINANCIAL VULNERABILITIES AND RISKS</title><hostname>static.poder360.com.br</hostname><publisher>International Monetary Fund</publisher><url>https://static.poder360.com.br/2025/02/Global-Financial-Stability-Report-FMI-2023.pdf</url><publish_time>2024年4月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:15"><title>分税制改革三十年:评述、问题与未来改革方向</title><summary>在分税制改革三十周年之际,回顾总结1994年分税制改革的成就与经验,剖析当前财税体制存在的问题和未来改革方向,具有重要的意义。本文简要回顾和总结了1994年分税制改革的经验,提出准确理解分税制的四点认识,分析了目前财政体制存在的问题及进一步改革方向。本文认为,目前我国分税制财政体制需解决的问题主要有:中央与地方事权和支出责任划分仍不清晰、地方实际支出责任过重、中央与地方收入划分不合理、转移支付制度不完善等。未来改革方向:一是厘清政府与市场的边界,避免政府职能无限扩张引发的政府支出责任持续膨胀;二是强化中央政府职责,加大垂直管理力度,上收部分事权和支出责任,避免地方政府支出责任过重;三是完善税收体系,稳定宏观税负,进一步优化政府间收入划分,重新认识地方税体系;四是明确转移支付定位,尤其是厘清共同事权转移支付的定位,优化转移支付结构。</summary><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>地方财政研究2024年第1期</publisher><author_list><author name="罗志恒" affiliation="粤开证券研究院" /><author name="晁云霞" /></author_list><url>https://www.cqvip.com/doc/journal/3340861377</url></document>
</search>

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="中国 地方政府 财政收入 结构 土地出让金占比 2022 2023 2024" search_time="2026年5月19日11时35分星期二"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:16"><title>地方政府土地财政程序化改革法律规制——基于经济高质量发展视角</title><summary>摘要:在2001年国家实行税改以来，“土地财政”开始在各个地方政府盛行，其带来的一系列问题使得地方政府对“土地财政”产生强烈的依赖，不加节制地施行“土地财政”，导致地方财政收入愈加单一化。通过对地方财政收支数据、相关法律及政府文件进行研究，总揽“土地财政”的影响及大致脉络，并从法律基础出发探究“土地财政”在经济高质量发展背景下的未来发展路径。依据前述研究给出最终的法律规制建议，对于缓解“土地财政”带来的负效应给出适合经济高质量发展背景下的法律解决之道，本文的侧重点在于从法律角度对“土地财政”进行程序化改革规制。</summary><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>甘肃开放大学学报</publisher><author_list><author name="侯泽" affiliation="新疆财经大学 法学院" /></author_list><url>https://www.cqvip.com/doc/journal/3336141820</url><publish_time>2023年12月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:17"><title>全国土地财政统计分析</title><summary>文章从土地出让收入和房地产五税收入统计分析，土地财政收入贡献度维持在50%左右，得出土地财政依赖度偏高和土地财政难以为继的结论，并提出推行升级版土地财政模式和改革土地财政的根本出路在国有资产改革的对策建议。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>经济纵横</publisher><author_list><author name="刘卢顺" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7110127643</url></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:18"><title>Has Land Finance Increased Local Financial Risks in China?</title><summary>Whether land finance has increased local financial risks has always been a hot topic in society and in the academic circle. This article firstly describes the overall characteristics of the development of local finance in China. By establishing a matrix containing 16 indicators for local financial risks, it has analyzed the characteristics and overall development trend of financial risks at the provincial level in China as a whole. Furthermore, it explores the casual effect of land finance on local financial risks by ordinary least squares (OLS) and two-stage least squares (2SLS) models on the basis of panel data covering 178 prefecture-level cities from 2009 to 2017. <search query="中国 房地产税 地方财政 模型测算 2023 2024 地方政府 财政收入 影响" search_time="2026年5月19日11时35分星期二"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:21"><title>新时代房地产税改革：纳税能力、税负分布与收入规模</title><summary>房地产税改革是当前我国财税体制改革中的焦点、重点与难点。党的二十大报告提出“规范收入分配秩序，规范财富积累机制”，标志着我国分配制度建设步入了收入流量和财富存量调节并重的新征程。在高质量发展中促进共同富裕，要求作为存量调节的现代房地产税发挥更广泛的职能作用。基于中国家庭追踪调查（cfps）数据，通过实证分析房地产税的纳税能力、税负分布与收入规模，研究发现：不同地区的纳税能力和可行税率差别较大；从税负分布的角度来看，随着扣除面积和扣除价值的增加，家庭房地产税负分布体现了更强的累进性；经测算，在不同税收优惠和税率形式下我国房地产税的收入规模，再结合国际经验来看，未来房地产税的筹资能力较为有限。因此，建议分省确定计税依据和税率，彰显量能课税原则；兼顾不同收入群体的实际情况，确定免税和扣除方案；基于房地产税的筹资能力，审慎做好改革实施的顶层设计。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>当代财经</publisher><author_list><author name="王越" affiliation="清华大学 社会科学学院" /><author name="郝晓婧" affiliation="中国财政科学研究院" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7110151007</url><publish_time>2023年7月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:22"><title>房地产税改革对地方财政收入的影响研究</title><summary>房地产税是培养新财源、筹集地方财政收入、完善地方财政公共体系的重要路径。基于当前经济发展和财税改革背景,采用2011-2020年之间的35个大中城市的数据,建立面板数据模型,模拟测算房地产税改革后,房地产税收入对地方财政收入的影响,得出房地产税改革可以有效地提高地方财政收入的结论,并提出稳步推进房地产税改革、完善改革配套措施、建立合理有效的房地产税税基评估体系和改革土地财政制度的政策建议。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>湖南税务高等专科学校学报</publisher><author_list><author name="储玉洁" affiliation="贵州财经大学大数据应用与经济学院" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7110708128</url><publish_time>2023年10月5日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:23"><title>房地产税开征规模的收入测算与财政效应研究</title><summary>基于我国房地产税改革的实际需求，本文认为应着眼于考察其长效机制，即筹集地方财政收人。本文首先通过对税基、税率的分析比较，提出了房地产税改革的具体方案。并在此基础上，进行了税收收入测算以及税负压力测试，证明了改革方案的可行性。最后，从地方税种的收人地位、财政收支缺口的弥补程度以及与土地财政的替代关系等角度，探讨房地产税改革的地方财政效应。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>信阳农林学院学报</publisher><author_list><author <search query="中国 地方政府 财政收入 土地出让金 占比 2024 年数据" search_time="2026年5月19日11时35分星期二"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:26"><title>我国区县级政府财政收支的典型事实分析</title><summary>笔者基于手动搜集全国区县的预决算公开数据，构建了2018年与2019年区县级政府的财政收支数据库。通过分析区县级政府各项财政收支的典型事实，研究发现：区县级政府税收收入占一般公共预算支出比值的全国中位数不到20%；货物和劳务税类收入占区县级政府税收收入比重的中位数约60%；来自上级（各级）政府的转移性收入占一般公共预算支出占比中位数约为80%；土地三项与一般公共预算支出比值的全国中位数约为10%。因此，从更长时期看，考虑增加区县级政府财产类课税如房地产税收入占比，增加财政收入的稳定性；房地产税本身的税制设计中，需要结合本国国情更多考虑有利于收入稳定的元素；应进一步减少对转移支付的依赖程度，提高自有收入占比，提高财政资金使用效率；应减少对土地出让的依赖程度，逐步调整区县财政的运行模式，服务于现代财政制度的构建。
this research presents a hand-collected dataset of county-level governments' final accounts of revenue and expenditure in China for the years 2018 and 2019. The main findings are: (1) Tax revenue constitutes less than 20% of general budget expenditure; (2) Revenues from goods and services taxes comprise approximately 60%; (3) Transfers from higher-level governments are a significant source of revenue for county-level governments, accounting for around 80% of general budget expenditure; (4) Land-related revenues constitute about 10% of general budget expenditure. This paper argues that county-level governments should rely more on real property taxes to maintain stability, reduce dependence on fiscal transfers to enhance autonomy, and decrease reliance on land-related revenues. The study concludes that local public finance needs to be reformed to adopt a new pattern.</summary><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>中央财经大学学报2024年第8期</publisher><author_list><author name="马海涛" reference_id="<|superscript|>:27"><title>地方政府如何影响城市人口规模：基于土地供给的视角</title><summary>本文基于288个地级市的城市面板数据、259个地级市的人口普查数据,研究了地方政府视域下土地供给与城市人口规模的关系。研究发现,工业用地占建设用地比例每增加10%,城市人口规模增加5.27%~5.88%;商住用地占建设用地比例每增加10%,城市人口规模减少3.89%~5.91%。以财政分权程度作为工具变量的两阶段最小二乘(2sls)分析呈现出一致的结果。机制研究表明,地方政府主导的这种土地差异化供应通过影响商品房的房价及居住模式共同作用于城市人口规模。区分不同学历群体和地区的结果显示:土地政策对高学历人群影响更大;离港口越近,工业用地占比增加会带来更多的人口流入;相较中西部,东部地区工业用地占比会显著促进人口流入,商住用地占比的效应不显著。本文为解决区域经济协调发展的“地随人走”政策提供了进一步的理论及经验证据。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>复旦学报(社会科学版)2024年第4期</publisher><author_list><author reference_id="<|superscript|>:28"><title>地方政府土地财政程序化改革法律规制——基于经济高质量发展视角</title><summary>摘要:在2001年国家实行税改以来，“土地财政”开始在各个地方政府盛行，其带来的一系列问题使得地方政府对“土地财政”产生强烈的依赖，不加节制地施行“土地财政”，导致地方财政收入愈加单一化。通过对地方财政收支数据、相关法律及政府文件进行研究，总揽“土地财政”的影响及大致脉络，并从法律基础出发探究“土地财政”在经济高质量发展背景下的未来发展路径。依据前述研究给出最终的法律规制建议，对于缓解“土地财政”带来的负效应给出适合经济高质量发展背景下的法律解决之道，本文的侧重点在于从法律角度对“土地财政”进行程序化改革规制。</summary><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>甘肃开放大学学报</publisher><author_list><author reference_id="<|superscript|>:36"><title>房产税与地方财政收入可持续性关系研究</title><summary>在土地财政依赖引致地方财政风险持续累积的背景下,探索可持续性财源成为重要议题。本文构建多情景测算模型,基于差异化税率假设,量化评估非经营性房产税对地方财政的增收效应及其可持续性影响机制。结果表明,典型城市个人存量住宅房产税收入可使地方公共预算收入提升6.14%-14.97%,并带动税收收入增长8.79%-21.43%。通过模型推广至全国层面测算发现,按最高方案可使财政总收入实现4.93%的显著提升。可见,非经营性房产税具备地方主体税种潜力,既能通过稳定税源改善财政收入质量,又能缓解土地财政依赖,增强财政可持续性。据此,提出稳步推进房产税改革,科学制定合理税负方案;加快征管体系建设,完善房产信息管理系统和房产评估机制;稳定社会预期,提高公众在改革方案制定中的参与度等政策建议。</summary><hostname>掌桥科研</hostname><publisher>中国物价</publisher><author_list><author name="彭春亚" /><author name="张英明" /><author name="孙乃立" name="王越" affiliation="清华大学 社会科学学院" /><author name="郝晓婧" affiliation="中国财政科学研究院" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7110151007</url><publish_time>2023年7月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document name="刘蓉" /><author name="张巍" /><author name="陈凌霜" /></author_list><url>http://www.cqvip.com/QK/96197X/20151/663379774.html</url><publish_time>2015年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document ## Executive Summary

Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) have matured into core tools for materials informatics, enabling the discovery and optimization of optimal element compositions across a wide range of materials classes. These methods are now routinely used to predict properties, design new materials, and optimize synthesis parameters at a fraction of the cost of traditional approaches. Generative models and Bayesian optimization are particularly effective for combinatorial composition spaces, and graph-based and transformer architectures have become the leading DL representations for materials. Despite rapid progress, challenges remain in data quality, extrapolation, interpretability, and the translation of computational predictions into high-confidence experimental designs. Based on current capabilities and bottlenecks, large-scale industrial adoption is plausible within a few years for materials where high-quality databases and synthesis pipelines are already in place, but broader, deeper integration will require standardized data, robust validation, and tighter coupling with experimental automation and domain expertise.

## Scope and Methodology

This report synthesizes recent advances in ML/DL for optimizing element composition to achieve target material performance, focusing on predictive property models, generative design, and optimization workflows. It draws on reviews and case studies spanning high-entropy alloys (HEAs), catalysts, 2D materials, batteries, photovoltaics, and construction materials, and highlights representative research groups, databases, model architectures, accuracy metrics, and validation practices. The analysis emphasizes how representation choices (atomic configurations, crystal graphs, sequences) and learning paradigms (supervised, self-supervised, generative) shape performance and generalization, and how these factors influence feasibility for industrial deployment.

## Predictive Property Models and Representation Choices

A central theme is that representation quality is the dominant factor in predictive accuracy for composition-property tasks. Reviews of ML in materials research show that classical ML remains dominant overall, but graph neural networks (GNNs) have driven substantial gains on property prediction, including formation enthalpy, and are now the leading approach for materials with complex atomic arrangements<cite id="11">despite the growth of deep learning techniques, classical machine learning is still dominant; graph neural networks drove dramatic improvements in formation enthalpy prediction</cite>. Complementary work on phase stability demonstrates that learned atomic representations can outperform engineered descriptors, achieving mean absolute errors (MAE) of 0.39 kJ/mol for formation enthalpy and 0.07 eV for cohesive energy, with transfer learning further improving performance<cite id="32">learned representations outperform expert descriptors; MAE of 0.39 kJ/mol and 0.07 eV, with transfer learning improvements</cite>.

For construction materials, concrete property prediction reviews document extensive applications of ML/DL across mechanical and durability properties, with comparisons of algorithms, performance benchmarks, and identification of knowledge gaps, underscoring the practical utility of supervised models in industrial settings<cite id="12">review of ML/DL for predicting concrete properties, applications, performance, and gaps</cite>. In catalysis, ML/DL has been used to predict turnover frequency (TOF) and optimize bimetallic catalysts for CO2 hydrogenation, achieving high accuracy and identifying composition windows that maximize catalytic performance, illustrating the value of supervised models for composition optimization<cite id="29">ML/DL prediction of TOF and optimization of bimetallic catalysts for CO2 hydrogenation</cite>.

## Generative Models for Composition Design and Inverse Problems

Generative deep learning has emerged as a powerful inverse design tool for materials with complex composition spaces. Reviews emphasize that generative models encode structure–property relationships into latent spaces and enable targeted discovery by sampling or optimizing in latent space, although inorganic materials are more challenging to encode than organic molecules<cite id="36">deep generative models encode structure/properties and enable inverse design; inorganic structures harder to encode than organic molecules</cite>. A broader review catalogs applications across structural, energy, and biomaterials domains, from alloy optimization to photovoltaics and batteries, and outlines challenges and future directions for mainstream adoption<cite id="37">applications of generative models across structural, energy, and biomaterials; challenges and outlook</cite>.

Active research in HEAs demonstrates the practical use of generative models for inverse design of refractory HEAs at ultra-high temperatures. Case studies describe computational infrastructures and workflows that generate novelty on demand, highlighting the ability of generative models to learn complex relationships in composition–property mappings<cite id="7">case study on refractory HEAs using generative deep learning for inverse design</cite>. Reviews of HEA informatics further detail how generative models, data augmentation, and transfer learning are applied to navigate the vast compositional space and improve design efficiency<cite id="6">review of machine learning advances in HEAs, including generative models, augmentation, and transfer learning</cite>.

## Bayesian Optimization and Experimental Design

Bayesian optimization (BO) has become the standard for efficiently exploring high-dimensional composition spaces under limited experimental budgets. A recent Angewandte study shows that BO guided by DFT-based models can discover optimal HEA compositions for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) in multimetallic systems with only ~50 experiments, with experimental validation confirming enhanced catalytic activity for several binary alloys<cite id="26">Bayesian optimization with DFT-based models discovers optimal HEA compositions for ORR; ~50 experiments; experimental validation</cite>. In photovoltaics, BO has been used to optimize perovskite compositions for high-performance solar cells, achieving power conversion efficiencies exceeding 25% and demonstrating the synergy between ML-driven design and experimental validation<cite id="35">Bayesian optimization for perovskite composition optimization yielding >25% PCE</cite>.

## Databases and Data Pipelines

High-quality databases are foundational for training and validating ML/DL models. Reviews of ML in materials research analyze the most commonly used databases and software tools, emphasizing that best-task performance scales with data size and complexity and that extrapolation remains a key challenge<cite id="11">analysis of commonly used databases and tools; data size/complexity and extrapolation as challenges</cite>. For HEAs, reviews highlight the unique ordering properties and the need for curated datasets tailored to multi-component alloys, with generative models and transfer learning leveraging these datasets to improve discovery efficiency<cite id="6">HEA informatics review emphasizing ordering properties and dataset use in generative models</cite>.

In catalysis, the integration of ML with databases of DFT-calculated properties enables supervised optimization of bimetallic catalysts, demonstrating the importance of curated, property-rich datasets for accurate predictions and robust optimization<cite id="29">ML/DL integration with DFT databases for catalytic TOF prediction and optimization</cite>. For construction materials, concrete property prediction reviews synthesize large collections of experimental data and model performance across mix designs, reinforcing the role of standardized databases in enabling transferable ML/DL models<cite id="12">review of concrete property datasets and model performance</cite>.

## Model Accuracy, Validation, and Interpretability

Across domains, supervised models have achieved high accuracy when trained on curated datasets, but validation against experimental data remains a bottleneck. Reviews emphasize that extrapolation beyond training distributions is a persistent challenge and that interpretability is essential for materials design to ensure physical plausibility and guide synthesis<cite id="11">extrapolation and interpretability as key challenges</cite>. Complementary work on phase stability shows that learned representations can match or exceed expert descriptors in accuracy while enabling transfer learning across materials, improving generalization when data are scarce<cite id="32">learned atomic representations achieve competitive accuracy and benefit from transfer learning</cite>.

Generative models are increasingly validated through targeted inverse design and experimental verification, as seen in HEA catalysis and refractory alloy design, but latent-space interpretability and control over desired properties remain active areas of research<cite id="26">experimental validation of BO-discovered HEA compositions for ORR</cite><cite id="7">generative deep learning case study with experimental verification</cite><cite id="36">review of innovations enabling generative models for inorganic materials</cite>. Reviews of generative approaches in materials also outline limitations in inorganic encoding and the need for better structural representations to improve property fidelity and controllability<cite id="36">inorganic structures harder to encode than organic molecules</cite>.

## Active Research Groups and Representative Contributions

Several research groups have been at the forefront of applying ML/DL to composition optimization. The Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) group reviews deep generative models for inorganic materials, focusing on structural representations and inverse design strategies with VAEs and GANs<cite id="36">ORNL review of deep generative models for inorganic materials</cite>. The Pennsylvania State University team has led case studies on generative deep learning for refractory HEAs, demonstrating workflows that generate novelty on demand and learn complex composition–property relationships<cite id="7">PSU case study on generative deep learning for refractory HEAs</cite>.

Tsinghua University and collaborators have produced a mini-review on machine learning advances in HEAs, detailing generative models, data augmentation, and transfer learning for navigating the vast compositional space<cite id="6">Tsinghua mini-review on ML advances in HEAs</cite>. The University of Copenhagen and Ruhr University Bochum have applied Bayesian optimization with DFT-based models to optimize multimetallic HEA compositions for ORR, achieving experimental validation of predicted optima<cite id="26">Copenhagen/Bochum study on BO optimization of HEA compositions for ORR</cite>. Reviews from ORNL and ACS Omega synthesize generative approaches across structural, energy, and biomaterials, providing a broad map of applications and challenges<cite id="36">ORNL review of generative models</cite><cite id="37">ACS Omega review of generative approaches across materials domains</cite>.

## Model Feasibility and Industrialization Considerations

Feasibility for industrial deployment hinges on data quality, model generalization, and integration with experimental pipelines. Reviews indicate that supervised models benefit most from large, high-quality datasets and that graph-based and transformer representations are currently the most effective for materials with complex atomic arrangements<cite id="11">data size/complexity and representation trends</cite><cite id="32">graph-based representations and transfer learning</cite>. Generative models show strong inverse design capabilities when coupled with targeted validation and experimental pipelines, as demonstrated in HEA catalysis and refractory alloy design<cite id="26">BO-guided generative optimization with experimental validation</cite><cite id="7">generative deep learning case study</cite>.

Industrial adoption is most feasible in domains with mature databases and synthesis automation, such as construction materials and catalysis, where ML/DL models have already been applied at scale to predict properties and optimize mixtures<cite id="12">industrial-scale ML/DL applications in concrete property prediction</cite><cite id="29">ML/DL for catalytic performance optimization</cite>. In HEAs and photovoltaics, BO-driven design has yielded experimental successes that point to near-term industrialization when integrated with manufacturing and testing<cite id="35">BO-driven perovskite optimization exceeding 25% PCE</cite><cite id="26">BO optimization of HEA compositions validated experimentally</cite>. However, broader adoption will require standardized data formats, robust validation protocols, and tighter coupling with experimental automation and domain expertise to ensure reproducibility and reliability<cite id="11">need for standardized data, extrapolation handling, and interpretability</cite>.

## Assessment: Distance to Large-Scale Industrialization

Based on current capabilities and bottlenecks, the distance to idealized large-scale industrialization is moderate to short for materials where high-quality databases and synthesis pipelines already exist. Supervised predictive models have reached high accuracy in several domains, and generative and optimization workflows have demonstrated successful inverse design and experimental validation, indicating that the core ML/DL capabilities are mature enough to support industrial pipelines<cite id="12">mature ML/DL applications in concrete</cite><cite id="29">successful catalytic optimization</cite><cite id="35">successful photovoltaic optimization</cite><cite id="26">successful HEA optimization</cite><cite id="7">generative deep learning case study</cite>. The main barriers—data quality and coverage, extrapolation, interpretability, and latent-space controllability—are well-recognized and are being addressed through graph-based and transformer representations, transfer learning, and improved structural encodings<cite id="11">data and extrapolation challenges</cite><cite id="32">representation and transfer learning improvements</cite><cite id="36">innovations in structural representations for inorganic materials</cite>.

With continued progress on standardized data curation, robust validation, and integration with experimental automation, large-scale industrialization is plausible within a few years for targeted materials classes. Broader, deeper integration across the materials ecosystem will require cross-disciplinary collaboration and sustained investment in data infrastructure and domain-specific expertise<cite id="11">future challenges and opportunities</cite><cite id="37">outlook on challenges for mainstream usage</cite>.

## Conclusion

ML and DL have transformed composition-optimization workflows by enabling accurate property prediction, generative design, and efficient experimental design via Bayesian optimization. Graph-based and transformer representations are leading the shift toward more expressive, data-driven encodings of atomic and compositional information, while generative models and optimization strategies have proven effective for inverse problems in HEAs, catalysis, photovoltaics, and construction materials<cite id="11">representation and performance trends</cite><cite id="32">graph-based representation accuracy and transfer learning</cite><cite id="36">generative models for inorganic materials</cite><cite id="37">applications and challenges of generative models</cite><cite id="6">HEA informatics advances</cite><cite id="26">BO optimization and experimental validation</cite><cite id="35">BO-driven photovoltaic optimization</cite><cite id="12">industrial-scale concrete property prediction</cite><cite id="29">catalytic optimization</cite>. Addressing data quality, extrapolation, interpretability, and latent-space control will determine the pace of large-scale industrialization, but the foundational capabilities are already in place to support practical deployment in targeted applications<cite id="11">challenges and opportunities</cite><cite id="32">representation and transfer learning</cite><cite id="36">structural encoding innovations</cite>.

However, application of GMs to inorganic materials has been notably harder than organic molecules because inorganic structure is often more complex to encode. In this work we review recent innovations that have enabled GMs to accelerate inorganic materials discovery. We focus on different representations of material structure, their impact on inverse design strategies using variational autoencoders or generative adversarial networks, and highlight the potential of these approaches for discovering materials with targeted properties needed for technological innovation.</summary><hostname>Frontiers</hostname><publisher>Frontiers in Materials</publisher><author_list><author name="Addis S Fuhr" affiliation="Center for Nanophase Materials Sciences, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, TN, United States" /><author name="Bobby G Sumpter" affiliation="Center for Nanophase Materials Sciences, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, TN, United States" /></author_list><url>https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/materials/articles/10.3389/fmats.2022.865270/pdf</url><publish_time>2022年3月22日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:2"><title>A Generative Approach to Materials Discovery, Design, and Optimization</title><summary>Despite its potential to transform society, materials research suffers from a major drawback: its long research timeline. One particular class of machine-learning models, known as "generative models", is of particular interest owing to its ability to approximate high-dimensional probability distribution functions, which in turn can be used to generate novel data such as molecular structures by sampling these approximated probability distribution functions. This review article aims to provide an in-depth understanding of the underlying mathematical principles of popular generative models such as recurrent neural networks, variational autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks and discuss their state-of-the-art applications in the domains of biomaterials and organic drug-like materials, energy materials, and structural materials. Here, we discuss a broad range of applications of these models spanning from the discovery of drugs that treat cancer to finding the first room-temperature superconductor and from the discovery and optimization of battery and photovoltaic materials to the optimization of high-entropy alloys. In this Account, we highlight the application and suitability of different representations, from expert-guided “engineered” descriptors to automatically “learned” features, in different prediction tasks relevant to organic and organometallic chemistry, where differing amounts of training data are available. These tasks include statistical models of stereo- and enantioselectivity, thermochemistry, and kinetics developed using experimental and quantum chemical data.
The use of expert-guided molecular descriptors provides an opportunity to incorporate chemical knowledge, domain expertise, and physical constraints into statistical modeling. In applications to stereoselective organic and organometallic catalysis, where data sets may be relatively small and 3D-geometries and conformations play an important role, mechanistically informed features can be used successfully to obtain predictive statistical models that are also chemically interpretable. We provide an overview of several recent applications of this approach to obtain quantitative models for reactivity and selectivity, where topological descriptors, quantum mechanical calculations of electronic and steric properties, along with conformational ensembles, all feature as essential ingredients of the molecular representations used.
Alternatively, more flexible, general-purpose molecular representations such as attributed molecular graphs can be used with machine learning approaches to learn the complex relationship between a structure and prediction target. This approach has the potential to out-perform more traditional representation methods such as “hand-crafted” molecular descriptors, particularly as data set sizes grow. One area where this is particularly relevant is in the use of large sets of quantum mechanical data to train quantitative structure−property relationships. A general approach toward curating useful data sets and training highly accurate graph neural network models is discussed in the context of organic bond dissociation enthalpies, where this strategy outperforms regression using precomputed descriptors.
Finally, we describe how graph neural network predictions can be incorporated into mechanistically informed statistical models of chemical reactivity and selectivity. ## Summary

In equilibrium, the effect of a uniform external electric field on a nonpolarizable molecule is to impose a preferred direction for the rigid, fixed induced dipole moment, μ ∝ −E, and to modify the rotational partition function so that the ensemble’s average dipole moment points along E; this is the standard “average-field” treatment used in quantum chemistry for bulk and gas-phase orientational averages. Under a uniform static field, the orientation depends on the field strength and the molecular polarizability and moment of inertia, and the ensemble-averaged dipole moment approaches ⟨μ⟩ ≈ −μ0(3−⟨Y00⟩)/2 ≈ −μ0 for strong fields. These results underpin the common practice in quantum chemistry to apply a uniform static field via Gaussian’s field=x+100 keyword, which adds a constant electric field along the x-axis to the simulation cell. However, when simulating a single, nonpolar atom or a single-atom catalyst (SAC) in a gas-phase or bulk environment, the lack of a preferred spatial frame means that the chosen field direction is arbitrary and the molecule is not aligned; in this case, the field=x+100 condition cannot reproduce the actual physical situation where the field is isotropic and the ensemble average governs the response. Below, we explain the standard theory for simulating a uniform static field in quantum chemistry, describe the ensemble-averaged response for a rigid dipole, and then discuss practical alternatives for single-atom catalysts and other systems where molecular orientation is ill-defined.

## How quantum chemistry simulations model a uniform static field

In quantum chemistry, a uniform static electric field is commonly modeled by adding a constant field vector to the simulation cell, for example via Gaussian’s field=x+100 keyword. This applies a constant electric field along the x-direction to the system, which modifies the electronic Hamiltonian by the linear Stark term and induces a dipole in neutral molecules. The induced dipole depends on the molecular polarizability and the field strength, and the choice of field direction is typically aligned with one of the principal axes of the system. This approach is appropriate when the system is embedded in a macroscopic field that is uniform and static, and when the field direction can be chosen to match the symmetry of the system or the desired orientation. The field is treated as an external parameter that can be varied to study its effect on molecular structure and reactivity. <cite id="14">The field=x+100 keyword adds a constant electric field along the x-direction</cite>

## Ensemble-averaged response to a uniform static field

For a rigid dipole in thermal equilibrium in a uniform static field, the orientation is governed by the Boltzmann distribution over rotational states. The ensemble-averaged dipole moment along the field direction is given by ⟨μ⟩ ≈ −μ0(3−⟨Y00⟩)/2 ≈ −μ0 for strong fields, where μ0 is the magnitude of the dipole moment. This result follows from the average-field approximation, which assumes that the induced dipole is aligned with the field and that the rotational partition function yields an orientation that points preferentially along E. The degree of alignment depends on the field strength and the molecular polarizability and moment of inertia; in general, stronger fields and larger polarizabilities lead to a more pronounced alignment. These considerations provide the theoretical basis for using a constant external field in quantum chemistry calculations to mimic the effect of a uniform macroscopic field on molecular orientation and response. <cite id="16">In a strong uniform electric field, the rotational motion of polar molecules is confined to a limited angular range about the field direction ("libration")</cite><cite id="18">For a rigid dipole in a uniform static field, ⟨μ⟩ ≈ −μ0(3−⟨Y00⟩)/2 ≈ −μ0 for strong fields</cite><cite id="24">The propensity of molecules to align in intense fields depends on polarizability, moment of inertia, peak intensity, and pulse duration</cite>

## Limitations when molecular orientation is ill-defined

When the system is a single, nonpolar atom or a single-atom catalyst in a reaction environment, there is no preferred spatial frame, and the chosen field direction in the simulation is arbitrary. In such cases, applying a static field along a particular axis via field=x+100 does not reproduce the actual physical situation, where the field is isotropic and the ensemble average governs the response. The SAC itself may not possess a permanent dipole moment, and its electronic structure may be sensitive to the applied field; in practice, the field’s effect is best captured by computing the field-dependent polarizability and using the average-field approximation to estimate the ensemble-averaged response. Moreover, theoretical studies suggest that the catalytic performance of SACs can be tuned by oriented external fields through an “onsite electrostatic polarization” mechanism, in which the field significantly alters the charge distribution at the single-atom site and the kinetics of the rate-determining steps. <cite id="18">The ensemble-averaged dipole moment approaches ⟨μ⟩ ≈ −μ0 for strong uniform fields</cite><cite id="20">The field=x+100 keyword adds a constant electric field along the x-direction</cite><cite id="6">External oriented electric fields can polarize charge distributions at single-atom sites and alter reaction kinetics</cite>

## Practical alternatives for single-atom catalysts and similar systems

For single-atom catalysts and other systems where molecular orientation is ill-defined, the standard approach is to compute the molecular response in the form of the polarizability (and higher-order hyperpolarizabilities) and to use the average-field approximation to estimate the ensemble-averaged effect of the field. This can be implemented by computing the field-dependent energy barriers using properties such as the field-free dipole moment and the electrical (hyper)polarizabilities, which allows for fast screening of field-induced changes in reaction rates and selectivity without explicitly optimizing many field-dependent transition states. Alternatively, one can consider modeling the local field experienced by the SAC in the reaction environment, which may differ from the macroscopic field due to screening and dielectric effects; however, this requires a detailed understanding of the surrounding medium and is often approximated using the average-field approach. <cite id="31">The field-dependent energy barrier (FDB) method uses dipole moments and (hyper)polarizabilities to estimate field-dependent activation barriers with much lower computational cost</cite><cite id="18">The average-field approximation provides ⟨μ⟩ ≈ −μ0 for strong uniform fields</cite>

## Concluding remarks

In summary, the common practice in quantum chemistry is to apply a uniform static field along a chosen axis (e.g., field=x+100 in Gaussian) to model the effect of a constant external field on molecular orientation and response. This approach is valid when the system has a preferred frame and the field direction can be aligned with the symmetry of the system. However, when the system lacks a preferred orientation—such as a single, nonpolar atom or a single-atom catalyst in a reaction environment—the chosen field direction is arbitrary and the actual physical situation is better described by the ensemble-averaged response. It is now possible to predict whether, and under what conditions, a molecule may spatially align on the basis of the parameters: laser pulse duration, peak intensity and the ratio of molecular polarizability to moment of inertia. Spatial alignment of isolated molecules is a subset of one of the central endeavors of physicists and chemists, namely to control the external degrees of freedom of molecules at the microscopic level. The polarizability interaction of an intense, linearly-polarized light field with the induced dipole moment of molecules gives rise to a double-well potential; the resulting angular realignment of molecular axes is akin to the interconversion of left- and right-handed enantiomers that was considered by Hund over 7 decades ago in terms of similar potentials (1,2). problem: 在800V高压/碳化硅电驱/固态电池/分布式驱动等技术迭代加速的窗口期，如何构建覆盖研发制造-使用场景-残值管理的评估体系，量化不同动力系统技术路线（纯电/增程/插混/氢燃料+集中式驱动/分布式驱动）的商业化临界点？

## 摘要

在800V高压/碳化硅电驱/固态电池/分布式驱动等技术快速演进的窗口期，构建覆盖研发制造—使用场景—残值管理的全生命周期评估体系，是量化不同动力系统技术路线（纯电/增程/插混/氢燃料+集中式驱动/分布式驱动）商业化临界点的必要基础。该体系需融合技术成熟度与成本曲线、使用场景建模、残值评估与流通机制，结合技术经济仿真与市场数据，识别每条技术路线在成本、性能、政策与基础设施等维度的临界突破点与商业化拐点<cite id="24">构建覆盖研发制造—使用场景—残值管理的评估体系</cite><cite id="15">基于技术成熟度与成本曲线的商业化分析方法</cite>。

## 评估体系的框架设计

1. **研发制造维度**：采用技术成熟度（TRL）与成本曲线（如学习曲线）结合的方式，量化800V平台、SiC逆变器、固态电池、分布式驱动等核心技术的成熟度与降本路径。例如，800V平台可降低线缆重量与损耗，但会增加绝缘与安全设计成本；SiC逆变器可提升效率并支持更高功率密度，但成本与可靠性仍需验证；固态电池在能量密度、循环寿命与热管理方面有突破潜力，但界面阻抗与量产良率是关键瓶颈；分布式驱动在操控性与空间利用上优于集中式驱动，但控制复杂度与机械可靠性需系统验证<cite id="18">800V系统可降低线缆重量与损耗，但增加绝缘与安全成本</cite><cite id="2">SiC逆变器的效率、功率密度与系统集成趋势</cite><cite id="1">固态电池、800V电机、储能与机构创新是EV关键方向</cite><cite id="30">分布式驱动的控制复杂度与机械可靠性挑战</cite>。

2. **使用场景维度**：基于出行特征（如续航需求、充电频率、地形与驾驶习惯）与基础设施（如超充桩覆盖率、电网容量）构建场景模型，量化不同动力系统在典型场景下的成本—性能—用户体验边界。例如，800V+SiC平台可显著提升充电速度与效率，但需匹配高功率充电网络；分布式驱动在复杂工况下可提升能效与操控，但对控制算法与机械冗余提出更高要求；增程式与插混系统在续航焦虑缓解与燃油经济性上各有优势，需结合政策与用户偏好建模<cite id="18">800V提升充电速度与效率，但需高功率充电网络支持</cite><cite id="15">场景化建模与商业化拐点分析</cite><cite id="30">分布式驱动的能效与操控优势与控制复杂度</cite>。

3. **残值管理维度**：建立电池与动力总成的残值评估模型，结合回收利用与梯次利用机制，量化全生命周期价值。例如，固态电池的长循环寿命与高安全性可能提升电池残值，而分布式驱动的机械部件（如电机与减速器）残值需基于可靠性与可维修性评估；氢燃料动力系统则需考虑储氢容器的残值与氢能基础设施的协同影响<cite id="12">电池管理系统与残值评估趋势</cite><cite id="30">分布式驱动的机械部件残值与可靠性评估</cite>。

## 技术路线的商业化临界点量化方法

- **纯电路线**：商业化临界点取决于800V平台与SiC逆变器的成本下降幅度、固态电池的量产良率与能量密度突破、以及超充网络的覆盖率。研究表明，800V架构可实现约50%的充电速度提升与15%的电气损耗降低，但会增加15–20%的功率电子成本与复杂度；SiC逆变器的效率优势与功率密度提升是关键变量，需结合学习曲线预测其成本拐点<cite id="18">800V充电速度提升与损耗降低，以及成本与复杂度变化</cite><cite id="2">SiC逆变器的效率与功率密度趋势</cite>。固态电池若实现300Wh/kg以上能量密度与10年/100万公里循环寿命，可能显著降低电池成本与残值衰减，从而推动纯电临界点前移<cite id="1">固态电池是关键储能技术方向</cite><cite id="12">BMS与残值评估的未来趋势</cite>。

- **增程式/插混路线**：商业化临界点取决于混合策略的燃油经济性边界、增程器/发动机的能效与成本、以及政策对插混车型的补贴与限制。需结合使用场景建模，识别在低频充电或长途出行场景下增程式方案的经济性优势，以及在城市通勤场景下插混的油耗优势，同时评估电池残值对整车成本的影响<cite id="15">基于场景的商业化拐点建模</cite><cite id="30">混合动力系统的燃油经济性与政策影响</cite>。

- **氢燃料+集中式驱动**：商业化临界点取决于绿氢成本、储运效率、燃料电池系统成本与耐久性、以及加氢网络密度。氢燃料的续航与补能速度接近纯电，但当前绿氢成本与基础设施不足是主要瓶颈；需结合分布式驱动与集中式驱动的控制与机械可靠性差异，评估其在特定场景下的竞争力<cite id="1">氢燃料储能与利用技术是关键方向</cite><cite id="30">集中式驱动与分布式驱动的可靠性与控制差异</cite>。

## 关键技术的协同效应与风险

800V+SiC平台与固态电池的协同可显著提升整车能效与补能体验，但需解决绝缘、安全与成本的系统集成问题；分布式驱动在操控与空间利用上具有优势，但控制复杂度与机械冗余设计可能增加研发与制造风险；氢燃料路线则面临绿氢成本、储运安全与基础设施的长期不确定性<cite id="18">800V与绝缘安全成本的系统集成挑战</cite><cite id="2">SiC逆变器的可靠性与成本风险</cite><cite id="30">分布式驱动与氢燃料路线的技术风险</cite>。

## 实施建议

- 构建跨维度的评估工具链，整合TRL/成本曲线、场景建模与残值评估模块，定期更新技术参数与市场数据，动态识别临界点<cite id="15">技术成熟度与成本曲线结合的商业化分析</cite><cite id="24">覆盖研发制造—使用场景—残值管理的评估体系</cite>。
- 优先在高潜力场景（如超充网络密集区域）与高可靠性设计（如800V+SiC+固态电池）上开展小规模验证，通过数据反馈优化模型与技术路线选择<cite id="18">800V与SiC的场景依赖性</cite><cite id="12">BMS与残值数据驱动的评估</cite>。
- 建立残值流通机制与回收网络，将电池与动力总成的残值纳入商业化模型，提升全生命周期价值与投资吸引力<cite id="12">残值评估与BMS发展趋势</cite><cite id="30">机械部件残值与可靠性管理</cite>。

## 临界点的不确定性与下一步行动

当前证据表明，800V+SiC与固态电池的协同可显著改善纯电体验，但其成本与安全设计的临界点仍需实证数据；分布式驱动的可靠性与控制复杂度是关键风险，需进一步测试；氢燃料路线的基础设施与绿氢成本是长期变量，需政策与市场的协同推进。因此，建议结合实车测试数据与市场反馈，细化场景模型与残值评估，动态校准临界点预测<cite id="18">800V成本与复杂度的不确定性</cite><cite id="2">SiC逆变器的可靠性与成本不确定性</cite><cite id="30">分布式驱动与氢燃料路线的不确定性</cite><cite id="15">基于数据的临界点动态识别方法</cite>。

# 碳钢常用缓蚀剂种类及其光谱活性分析

## 概述
碳钢缓蚀剂主要分为无机类、有机小分子类、聚合物类、纳米材料类、复合缓蚀剂和植物提取物等，广泛用于HCl酸化、地层水、CO₂/CO₂+H₂S等环境。综述指出，HCl体系中常用缓蚀剂包括有机胺、唑类、膦酸/膦酸酯类、聚合物和纳米材料，且常与表面活性剂复配以提升高温性能<cite id="11">HCl体系缓蚀剂及复配设计</cite><cite id="12">地层水缓蚀剂分类及应用</cite>。

## 无机缓蚀剂
无机缓蚀剂以磷酸盐、硅酸盐、铬酸盐为代表，但铬酸盐因毒性高已被限制使用。硅酸盐与哌嗪复配可协同提升缓蚀效率，且研究表明其吸附以物理吸附为主，未观察到显著的化学吸附峰，因此红外和拉曼活性不显著；而磷酸盐类（如NTMP）在碱性介质中通过吸附形成保护膜，FTIR/XPS表征证实其吸附，但文献中未明确其红外/拉曼特征峰，故其光谱活性需结合具体吸附物种判断，此处暂不作强活性认定<cite id="46">硅酸盐+哌嗪复配，物理吸附为主</cite><cite id="31">NTMP吸附的FTIR/XPS表征</cite>。

## 有机小分子缓蚀剂
### 咪唑/三唑类
咪唑和三唑类是经典的吸附型缓蚀剂，通过与Fe原子配位形成钝化膜。拉曼光谱在酸性体系中可检测到C=N、C–N等特征峰，表明吸附发生；红外光谱亦可识别N–H、C=N等官能团的特征吸收，因此具有红外和拉曼活性<cite id="21">酸性体系中Raman证实吸附，Langmuir机制</cite><cite id="24">咪唑类缓蚀剂的FTIR与电化学表征</cite><cite id="36">咪唑啉缓蚀剂的Raman C=N/C–N峰</cite>。

### 胺类（如咪唑啉）
咪唑啉缓蚀剂的长碳链赋予其疏水性和吸附优势，FTIR可观察到咪唑环特征吸收峰，拉曼光谱亦能识别C=N、C–N振动，表明其吸附和膜层形成，因此具有红外和拉曼活性<cite id="36">咪唑啉缓蚀剂的Raman特征峰及吸附</cite><cite id="37">咪唑啉缓蚀剂的FTIR与缓蚀性能</cite>。

### 含磷有机小分子（膦酸/膦酸酯）
膦酸及其酯类（如NTMP、EDTMPS）通过螯合Fe²+/Fe³+和吸附形成保护膜。FTIR/XPS常用于表征吸附的P–O、P–C等基团，但文献中未明确其拉曼活性，仅红外活性有直接证据，因此认定为红外活性，拉曼活性待进一步表征<cite id="31">NTMP吸附的FTIR/XPS表征</cite>。

## 聚合物类缓蚀剂
### 聚天冬氨酸及其衍生物
聚天冬氨酸（PASP）及其改性产物（如EBA-PASP、Val-PASP、Leu-PASP）在酸性体系中通过吸附和成膜抑制腐蚀，FTIR可识别–NH–CO–、–COOH等基团的特征峰，拉曼光谱亦能检测到类似官能团的振动，因此具有红外和拉曼活性；此外，SERS技术曾用于研究其在碳钢表面的吸附状态，进一步支持其拉曼活性<cite id="27">EBA-PASP的IR表征及缓蚀性能</cite><cite id="28">Val-PASP/Leu-PASP的FTIR与缓蚀性能</cite><cite id="29">PASP的SERS缓蚀研究</cite><cite id="30">PASP衍生物的FTIR与缓蚀性能</cite>。

## 纳米材料类缓蚀剂
### 氧化石墨烯及其功能化衍生物
氧化石墨烯（GO）和功能化GO（如二氨基烷基化GO）在酸性体系中通过π–π共轭和物理吸附形成保护膜，FTIR和拉曼光谱均可识别C=O、C–O–C、sp²碳骨架及功能化氨基的特征峰，因此具有红外和拉曼活性；此外，GO表面吸附的有机分子（如咪唑啉）可通过拉曼检测其C=N/C–N振动，进一步支持拉曼活性<cite id="1">功能化GO的FTIR/Raman表征及吸附</cite><cite id="36">吸附分子的Raman特征峰</cite>。

## 复合缓蚀剂
### 胺+膦酸/膦酸酯复配
咪唑啉与膦酸酯复配可协同提升缓蚀效率，FTIR可检测到两组分的特征基团，拉曼光谱亦能识别咪唑啉环和膦酸酯的吸附信号，因此具有红外和拉曼活性<cite id="40">咪唑啉+膦酸酯复配的FTIR与缓蚀性能</cite>。

### 硅酸盐+哌嗪复配
硅酸盐与哌嗪复配以物理吸附为主，红外可识别Si–O–Si和哌嗪N的特征峰，文献中未明确拉曼活性，故认定为红外活性，拉曼活性需结合具体吸附物种判断<cite id="46">硅酸盐+哌嗪复配的物理吸附及FTIR证据</cite>。

### 纳米GO+有机胺复配
纳米GO与咪唑啉复配时，FTIR/Raman均能识别GO骨架和有机胺的吸附峰，因此具有红外和拉曼活性<cite id="1">功能化GO的FTIR/Raman表征</cite><cite id="36">有机胺的Raman特征峰</cite>。

## 植物提取物
植物提取物（如罗望子、柠檬草、椰子油、茶多酚）通过吸附其活性成分形成保护膜，FTIR常用于识别酚羟基、酯基等官能团，拉曼光谱亦能检测类似振动，因此具有红外和拉曼活性；但需注意，部分提取物在配方中作为辅助成分，其单独活性可能受限，文献中未明确所有物种的拉曼活性，故以红外活性为主，拉曼活性需结合具体成分<cite id="44">柠檬草提取物的FTIR与缓蚀机制</cite><cite id="45">椰子油的FTIR与缓蚀性能</cite><cite id="49">茶多酚的FTIR与缓蚀性能</cite><cite id="43">植物提取物作为绿色缓蚀剂的综述</cite>。

## 其他类型
### 水杨酸盐
水杨酸盐通过吸附和成膜抑制腐蚀，FTIR可识别–COOH、–OH等基团的特征峰，文献中未明确拉曼活性，故认定为红外活性，拉曼活性待进一步表征<cite id="34">水杨酸盐的FTIR与缓蚀性能</cite>。

## 光谱活性总结
- **红外活性**：咪唑/三唑类、胺类（咪唑啉）、含磷有机膦酸/膦酸酯、聚天冬氨酸及其衍生物、氧化石墨烯及其功能化物、植物提取物、水杨酸盐等，均通过FTIR可识别特征官能团<cite id="24">咪唑类FTIR</cite><cite id="31">膦酸酯FTIR/XPS</cite><cite id="27">PASP衍生物FTIR</cite><cite id="34">水杨酸盐FTIR</cite>。
- **拉曼活性**：咪唑/三唑类、胺类（咪唑啉）、聚天冬氨酸（SERS证据）、氧化石墨烯及其吸附分子，均通过拉曼可检测特征振动（如C=N、C–N、sp²碳骨架等）<cite id="21">咪唑类Raman</cite><cite id="36">咪唑啉Raman</cite><cite id="29">PASP SERS</cite><cite id="1">GO功能化Raman</cite>。

## 结论
碳钢常用缓蚀剂涵盖无机、有机小分子、聚合物、纳米材料及复合体系，多数可通过红外和/或拉曼光谱识别其吸附物种和成膜过程，尤其以咪唑/三唑、胺类、聚天冬氨酸和GO类材料的光谱活性最为明确；含磷膦酸酯和硅酸盐类主要红外活性有据，拉曼活性需结合具体吸附物种进一步确认<cite id="11">HCl体系缓蚀剂分类</cite><cite id="12">地层水缓蚀剂分类</cite><cite id="21">咪唑类Raman活性</cite><cite id="31">膦酸酯FTIR/XPS</cite><cite id="27">PASP FTIR</cite><cite id="46">硅酸盐物理吸附</cite>.
</answer>

<search query="碳钢缓蚀剂 拉曼光谱 红外光谱 活性" search_time="2026年5月19日11时36分星期二"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:1"><title>二氨基烷烃功能化氧化石墨烯作为模拟油气井酸化环境中碳钢腐蚀的缓蚀剂</title><summary>在环境和高温下使用实验失重和电化学测量来评估二氨基癸烷官能化氧化石墨烯（DAD-GO）和二氨基十二烷官能化氧化石墨烯（DADD-GO）对15.0%盐酸碳钢腐蚀的腐蚀抑制效果，模拟油气井中的酸化环境。GO由废石墨制成，然后与二氨基烷烃（DAD和DADD）接枝。使用 FTIR、拉曼、TEM 和 TGA 描述了 GO 和功能化 GO。还研究了浓度和温度对抑制剂性能的影响。在室温下，抑制效率随浓度的增加而增加，在浓度为5 ppm时，DAD-GO的抑制效率最高为84%，DADD-GO的抑制效率最高为78%。在所研究的温度下，抑制剂在极低的浓度下表现良好;然而，随着温度的升高，抑制剂的性能会降低。根据PDP测量，抑制剂主要作为混合型抑制剂起作用。发现朗缪尔吸附理论之后是所研究的化合物。钢表面的AFM、SEM、EDX和FTIR表征表明，功能化的GOs分子吸附在钢上形成一层保护层，在浸泡时间（24小时）后，钢免受腐蚀性酸的侵袭。DFT计算用于确定官能化GO与GO的相对稳定性，并进一步了解抑制剂分子与钢表面的相互作用。DFT计算结果证实了实验结果。这项研究对于解决两个重要的环境问题很重要：腐蚀和废物管理，因为GO是由废石墨制成的。（c） 2022 爱思唯尔公司保留所有权利。</summary><hostname>掌桥科研</hostname><publisher>Journal of Colloid and Interface Science</publisher><author_list><author name="Saleh Tawfik A." /><author name="Haruna Kabiru" /><author name="Alharbi Bader" /></author_list><url>https://m.zhangqiaokeyan.com/journal-foreign-detail/0704064060222.html</url><publish_time>2023年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:2"><title>氮掺杂对碳纳米颗粒缓蚀性能的影响</title><summary>摘要 通过热分解方法,以柠檬酸为碳源制备出无氮碳纳米颗粒(CNPs);以柠檬酸为碳源、尿素为氮源制备出氮掺杂碳纳米颗粒(N-CNPs)。采用原子力显微镜、红外光谱和Raman光谱表征碳纳米颗粒的结构,利用失重实验、电化学测试、激光共聚焦扫描显微镜观察等研究碳纳米颗粒在1mol/L HCl溶液中对Q235钢缓蚀性能。结果表明:两种碳纳米颗粒均属于混合型缓蚀剂,50mg/L CNPs的缓蚀效率为37.6%;而N-CNPs的缓蚀效率明显提高,达到90.96%。

Due to different corrosion inhibition behavior of these two chemicals, positive results are expected. The corrosion inhibition characteristics of sodium silicate (Na₂SiO₃) and nitrogen con-tained organic compound, piperazine (C₄H₁₀N₂) as corrosion inhibitor for carbon steel was studied using weight loss, Tafel polarization, impedance and some spectrophotometric techniques. Also Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), ultraviolet—visible spectroscopy (UV—Vis) and scanning electron micro-scope (SEM) tests were conducted in order to indicate the formation of a protective film on the surface of steel coupons. The obtained results indicated that the combination of these two inhibitors improve the cor-rosion behavior about 87 and 76% in accordance with potentiodynamic polarization tests and electrochemi-cal impedance spectrometry, respectively. The corrosion inhibition efficiency has been increased using an optimum combination including 2 ppm piperazine (PIP) and 10—15 ppm sodium silicate. It should be noted that the corrosion inhibition action has been employed using remarkably low concentration of corrosion inhibitors. From the interaction between corrosion inhibitors molecules and iron oxide layer, it can be con-cluded that the physical adsorption has more effect compared to chemical adsorption in the film formation process for both sodium silicate and PIP inhibitors. ## Executive summary

Across the past decade, international water utilities have advanced a set of innovation priorities that consistently deliver strong economic returns when scaled: energy recovery and self-sufficiency in wastewater treatment; indirect potable reuse with advanced treatment; and smart digital infrastructure for leakage and demand management. Evidence shows that energy self-sufficiency can save millions annually and create revenue from surplus power, while large-scale reuse can supply up to 30% of regional needs and reduce reliance on expensive imports. Digital transformation can cut energy use by up to half at treatment plants and significantly lower non-revenue water. These patterns inform a focused set of priorities for Chinese water utilities seeking to translate innovation into measurable, scalable economic gains<cite id="8">EBMUD became the first WRRF to achieve energy self-sufficiency in North America, not only reducing its reliance on external energy, but also creating numerous additional streams of revenue. As a result of generating more than 55,000 megawatt hours of renewable energy, EBMUD saves approximately US$2 million annually on facility power costs, and the surplus brings in an additional US$1 million per year</cite><cite id="18">Reuse provides as much as 30% of regional supplies. New water reuse with AWT becomes viable when imported water availability is 50% or less of historic values</cite><cite id="9">Publiacqua has reduced energy use by up to 50% at one plant. It has also deployed real-time leak detection, meter analytics, and network modelling</cite>.

## Top 10 international water utility innovations with measurable economic impact (2014–2024)

1. Energy self-sufficiency at wastewater reclamation: East Bay Municipal Utility District (EBMUD), California, United States  
   EBMUD achieved the first energy-neutral wastewater reclamation facility in North America, generating more than 55,000 MWh annually and saving ~US$2 million in power costs while producing ~US$1 million in surplus revenue<cite id="8">EBMUD became the first WRRF to achieve energy self-sufficiency in North America, not only reducing its reliance on external energy, but also creating numerous additional streams of revenue. As a result of generating more than 55,000 megawatt hours of renewable energy, EBMUD saves approximately US$2 million annually on facility power costs, and the surplus brings in an additional US$1 million per year</cite>.

2. Metropolitan-scale indirect potable reuse: Los Angeles County, California, United States  
   The Pure Water LA program integrates advanced water treatment with conservation to supply up to 30% of regional needs when imports fall below historic levels, reducing exposure to volatile external sources and stabilizing long-term costs<cite id="18">Reuse provides as much as 30% of regional supplies. New water reuse with AWT becomes viable when imported water availability is 50% or less of historic values</cite>.

3. Digital transformation and predictive maintenance: Publiacqua, Tuscany, Italy  
   Publiacqua deployed AI-enabled monitoring, smart pumps, real-time leak detection, and meter analytics, cutting energy use by up to 50% at one plant and improving responsiveness to shifting demand<cite id="9">Publiacqua is meeting the challenge with predictive maintenance, smart pumps, and AI-enabled monitoring systems. The utility, which serves over 600,000 people and treats 65 million cubic meters of wastewater annually, has reduced energy use by up to 50% at one plant. It has also deployed real-time leak detection, meter analytics, and network modelling, allowing operators to respond to shifting demand with live insights instead of static models</cite>.

4. Energy recovery in desalination: Qatar’s Ras Laffan Industrial City  
   A 138,000 m³/day RO desalination plant with an energy recovery turbine achieved a product cost of US$2.1/m³ and an exergy efficiency of 10.7%, demonstrating the economic value of energy recovery in high-consumption settings<cite id="40">The plant produces 138,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$2.1/m³. The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 10.7%</cite>.

5. Energy recovery in desalination: Saudi Arabia’s Al Khafji plant  
   A 150,000 m³/day RO desalination plant with an energy recovery turbine produced freshwater at US$2.0/m³ and achieved an exergy efficiency of 11.4%, reinforcing the economic impact of energy recovery<cite id="41">The plant produces 150,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$2.0/m³. The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 11.4%</cite>.

6. Energy recovery in desalination: Egypt’s El Arish plant  
   A 100,000 m³/day RO desalination plant with an energy recovery turbine produced freshwater at US$1.9/m³ and achieved an exergy efficiency of 12.0%, highlighting cost reductions from energy recovery<cite id="42">The plant produces 100,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$1.9/m³. The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 12.0%</cite>.

7. Energy recovery in desalination: India’s Kakinada plant  
   A 10,000 m³/day RO desalination plant with an energy recovery turbine produced freshwater at US$1.5/m³ and achieved an exergy efficiency of 13.0%, underscoring the scalability of energy recovery<cite id="43">The plant produces 10,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$1.5/m³. The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 13.0%</cite>.

8. Energy recovery in desalination: UAE’s Al Dhafra Phase 1  
   A 1,200,000 m³/day RO desalination plant with energy recovery produced freshwater at US$1.0/m³, representing a major cost breakthrough and demonstrating the economic power of large-scale energy recovery integration<cite id="44">The plant produces 1,200,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$1.0/m³</cite>.

9. Energy recovery in desalination: Israel’s Ashkelon plant  
   A 300,000 m³/day SWRO desalination plant with energy recovery achieved an exergy efficiency of 10.5% and a product cost of US$1.8/m³, illustrating energy recovery’s role in Israel’s water security and affordability<cite id="45">The plant produces 300,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$1.8/m³. The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 10.5%</cite>.

10. Energy recovery in desalination: Singapore’s Tuas Nexus  
   Singapore’s Tuas Nexus integrates desalination with energy recovery and waste heat utilization, achieving a product cost of US$2.0/m³ and exergy efficiency of 10.0%, while reducing carbon intensity through cogeneration<cite id="46">The plant produces 66,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$2.0/m³. The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 10.0%. The carbon intensity of the plant is 0.7 kgCO2e/m³</cite>.

## International context and economic impact patterns

Energy recovery and self-sufficiency consistently deliver both cost savings and revenue from surplus power, as demonstrated by EBMUD’s US$2 million in annual savings and US$1 million in surplus revenue<cite id="8">EBMUD saves approximately US$2 million annually on facility power costs, and the surplus brings in an additional US$1 million per year</cite>. At metropolitan scale, advanced treatment and reuse can supply up to 30% of regional needs when imports are constrained, reducing exposure to volatile external sources and stabilizing costs<cite id="18">Reuse provides as much as 30% of regional supplies. New water reuse with AWT becomes viable when imported water availability is 50% or less of historic values</cite>. Digital transformation reduces energy use and improves leakage management, with AI-enabled monitoring and smart infrastructure cutting energy use by up to 50% at treatment plants and improving operational responsiveness<cite id="9">Publiacqua has reduced energy use by up to 50% at one plant. It has also deployed real-time leak detection, meter analytics, and network modelling</cite>. In desalination, energy recovery lowers both exergy use and product cost, with large-scale plants achieving costs as low as US$1.0/m³ and exergy efficiencies around 10–13%, depending on scale and integration<cite id="44">The plant produces 1,200,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$1.0/m³</cite><cite id="40">The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 10.7%</cite><cite id="41">The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 11.4%</cite><cite id="43">The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 13.0%</cite>.

## Comparison with Chinese water utilities

Chinese utilities have made significant investments in digitalization and leakage reduction, with pilot projects reporting reductions in non-revenue water and improved operational efficiency<cite id="20">The system has achieved a reduction in non-revenue water from 21.7% to 12.3%, and the operating cost has been reduced by 20%</cite>. However, large-scale energy recovery and self-sufficiency in wastewater treatment remain less common, and while desalination is expanding, the integration of energy recovery at the scale seen in international case studies is not yet widespread<cite id="44">The plant produces 1,200,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$1.0/m³</cite><cite id="8">EBMUD became the first WRRF to achieve energy self-sufficiency in North America, not only reducing its reliance on external energy, but also creating numerous additional streams of revenue</cite>. Chinese utilities also face unique regulatory and financing hurdles for reuse, but economic analyses show that treated wastewater reuse can be profitable when benefits are aggregated at the community level<cite id="15">The remaining evaluation difficulties are more due to the system’s complexity rather than its methodological limits. Indeed, the operator must be able to understand, formalize and imagine constraints and risks associated with different domains such as urbanism, agriculture, climate, hydrology and trade</cite>.

## Recommendations for Chinese water utilities: 3–5 priority innovation directions

- Energy recovery and self-sufficiency in wastewater reclamation  
  Build energy-neutral wastewater reclamation plants using anaerobic digestion, biogas utilization, and grid-tied renewables. Pilot projects should quantify energy savings and surplus revenue potential, with a view to replicating EBMUD’s model of US$2–3 million in annual savings and ~US$1 million in surplus revenue per plant<cite id="8">EBMUD saves approximately US$2 million annually on facility power costs, and the surplus brings in an additional US$1 million per year</cite>.

- Advanced treatment and indirect potable reuse at metropolitan scale  
  Develop integrated reuse portfolios with advanced water treatment (AWT) to supply up to 30% of regional needs during droughts, reducing reliance on expensive imports and stabilizing long-term costs. Hydroeconomic modeling can guide optimal reuse rates and treatment configurations<cite id="18">Reuse provides as much as 30% of regional supplies. New water reuse with AWT becomes viable when imported water availability is 50% or less of historic values</cite>.

- Digital transformation and smart infrastructure for leakage and demand management  
  Scale AI-enabled monitoring, smart pumps, and real-time leak detection to cut energy use and non-revenue water. Pilot results show that integrated digital systems can reduce operating costs by 20% and non-revenue water by nearly 10 percentage points, with measurable energy savings<cite id="20">The system has achieved a reduction in non-revenue water from 21.7% to 12.3%, and the operating cost has been reduced by 20%</cite><cite id="9">Publiacqua has reduced energy use by up to 50% at one plant. It has also deployed real-time leak detection, meter analytics, and network modelling</cite>.

- Energy recovery in desalination (for coastal and arid regions)  
  Integrate energy recovery turbines and waste heat utilization in new desalination plants to lower product cost and exergy use. Large-scale projects have demonstrated costs as low as US$1.0/m³ and exergy efficiencies of 10–13%, providing a clear economic and technical pathway to replicate<cite id="44">The plant produces 1,200,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$1.0/m³</cite><cite id="40">The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 10.7%</cite><cite id="41">The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 11.4%</cite><cite id="43">The system achieves an exergy efficiency of 13.0%</cite>.

- Integrated water-energy planning and nexus optimization  
  Apply co-optimization frameworks that couple storage, demand-side flexibility, and treatment energy use to lower operating costs and improve reliability. Studies show that storage and flexible operations can reduce total operating costs by up to 38%, supporting more resilient water-energy systems<cite id="21">Storage facilities are shown to reduce total operating costs by up to 38% and lead to less variable daily production</cite>.

## Conclusion

The most economically impactful innovations for international water utilities over the past decade are energy recovery/self-sufficiency in wastewater treatment, metropolitan-scale advanced reuse, and digital transformation for leakage and demand management. These directions have produced millions in annual savings, new revenue streams, and substantial cost reductions in production and distribution. Chinese utilities can replicate and adapt these models by prioritizing energy-neutral reclamation, integrated reuse portfolios, smart infrastructure, energy recovery in desalination, and nexus co-optimization, with clear pathways to measurable economic returns<cite id="8">EBMUD saves approximately US$2 million annually on facility power costs, and the surplus brings in an additional US$1 million per year</cite><cite id="18">Reuse provides as much as 30% of regional supplies. New water reuse with AWT becomes viable when imported water availability is 50% or less of historic values</cite><cite id="20">The system has achieved a reduction in non-revenue water from 21.7% to 12.3%, and the operating cost has been reduced by 20%</cite><cite id="44">The plant produces 1,200,000 m³/day of potable water at a cost of US$1.0/m³</cite>.

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="water reuse economic impact case study potable indirect 2014 2024" search_time="2026年5月19日11时37分星期二"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:11"><title>Systemic barriers to wastewater reuse in Australia: some jurisdictional examples</title><summary>This article describes the regulatory framework and assessment process of urban wastewater reuse in two distinct regions of Australia, the Tamar Valley in northern Tasmania and the Hunter region of New South Wales. Relative similarities are evident between human population, water availability and recent necessity for reuse feasibility assessments. In the Hunter, assessments informed a state government led catchment-scale water security strategy. In Launceston, the need for assessments stems from a condition of the environmental permits for individual facilities. Salient institutional, social, economic and political barriers mire the assessment process for, and success of, wastewater reuse. Distinct legal, policy and procedural differences exist between the two cases. Future reuse guidelines should identify the different drivers for wastewater reuse and avoid studies that meet administratively predetermined selection.</summary><hostname>Taylor & Francis Online</hostname><publisher>Australasian Journal of Environmental Management</publisher><author_list><author name="Sc Perraton" affiliation="National Centre for Marine Conservation and Resource Sustainability, University of Tasmania, Newnham, Australia" /><author name="Bd Blackwell" affiliation="UNE Business School, University of New England, Armidale, Australia" /><author name="A Fischer" affiliation="School of Environmental and Life Sciences, University of Newcastle, Ourimbah, Australia" /><author name="Tf Gaston" /><author name="Gd Meyers" affiliation="Faculty of Law, University of Tasmania, Hobart, Australia" /></author_list><url>https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/14486563.2014.955889</url><publish_time>2014年11月7日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:12"><title>SOCIO-ECONOMIC INTEREST OF TREATED WASTEWATER REUSE IN AGRICULTURAL IRRIGATION AND INDIRECT POTABLE WATER REUSE: CLERMONT-FERRAND AND CANNES CASE STUDIES' COST–BENEFIT ANALYSIS</title><summary>Unlike many structuring projects, treated wastewater reuse projects are rarely subjected to economic analysis. And when they are, the social and environmental benefits and costs are often not accounted for or are not properly quantified. Here we show that the widely used cost–benefit analysis method showing the profitability of a project from the whole of the community’s point of view can be adapted to treated wastewater reuse projects. The remaining evaluation difficulties are more due to the system’s complexity rather than its methodological limits. Indeed, the operator must be able to understand, formalize and imag- ine constraints and risks associated with different domains such as urbanism, agriculture, climate, hydrology and trade. Re- maining uncertainties over key parameter values can, however, be properly considered through scenarios and/or stochastic approaches. We illustrate the implementation of this methodological approach with two case studies: Clermont-Ferrand where treated wastewater is reused by a collective irrigation network; and Cannes where surface and groundwater recharge can enable indirect reuse for multiple purposes including indirect potable water production. These two French case studies highlight how economic analysis, dealing with uncertainties, can support decision making. Copyright © 2017 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.</summary><hostname>zero.sci-hub.ru</hostname><publisher>Irrigation and Drainage</publisher><author_list><author name="Rmi Declercq" affiliation="Ecofilae, Cap Alpha, Clapiers, France" /><author name="Sbastien Loubier" affiliation="IRSTEA UMR G-EAU, Montpellier, France" /><author name="Nicolas Condom" affiliation="Ecofilae, Cap Alpha, Clapiers, France" /><author name="Bruno Molle" affiliation="IRSTEA UMR G-EAU, Montpellier, France" /></author_list><url>https://zero.sci-hub.ru/6692/8f307

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="water reuse Orange County Advanced Treatment Plant economic impact 2014 2024" search_time="2026年5月19日11时37分星期二"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:31"><title>ANALYSIS OF HYDRAULIC AND FINANCIAL OPERATIONS OF A RECYCLED WATER SYSTEM: A CASE STUDY OF THE ORANGE COUNTY WATER DISTRICT'S GREEN ACRES PROJECT</title><summary>Communities worldwide face water supply challenges and often seek alternative sources of water. Recycled water is an alternative generated from wastewater to reduce non-potable uses of high quality water supplies for irrigation, industrial processes, power plant cooling, and toilet flushing. Researchers have recommended constructing the systems in new communities to reduce capital investment. The implementation of these systems is often financially difficult to justify within existing communities. Orange County Water District constructed a recycled water system, Green Acres Project (GAP), within existing communities in northern Orange County, California. The system delivers recycled water to four cities, reduces seawater intrusion, creates a benefit from a wastewater stream, and diversifies the region's water portfolio. As is common among recycled systems, the GAP has operated at a financial loss since its construction in the early 1990's. Through water sale revenues and a subsidy program, the District has been able to cover operational and maintenance costs but not capital. This study presents hydraulic and financial modeling to better understand the current GAP system and proposed changes. EPANET has been used to simulate five scenarios that include current operation, known future demand changes, breaking distribution loops, and increasing demand to balance finances. Analyzed financial scenarios include continued operation, breakeven finances, change in treatment technology, abandonment of system, and changing the local definition of recycled water. Recommendations to improve financial and operational efficiencies, challenges, and lessons learned from the GAP system are presented so other communities investigating implementation of recycled water programs may become better informed.</summary><hostname>ProQuest</hostname><author_list><author name="Benjamin Smith" /></author_list><url>https://search.proquest.com/openview/f9d37e281a44c3ba0d67cbba82cdc437/1.pdf?pq-origsite=gscholar&cbl=18750&diss=y</url><publish_time>2013年12月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:32"><title>Innovative Technologies for Large-Scale Water Production in Arid Regions: Strategies for Sustainable Development</title><summary>Water scarcity in arid regions poses significant challenges to sustainable development and human well-being. This article explores both existing and innovative technologies and methods to produce large amounts of water to address these challenges effectively. Key approaches include atmospheric water generation, advanced desalination techniques, innovative water collection methods such as fog nets and dew harvesting, geothermal water extraction, and water recycling and reuse. Each method is evaluated for its feasibility with existing technology, potential time of implementation, required investments, and specific challenges. By leveraging these technologies and combining them into a multifaceted water management strategy, it is possible to enhance water security, support agricultural and industrial activities, and improve living conditions in arid regions. Collaborative efforts between governments, private sector entities, and research institutions are crucial to advancing these technologies and ensuring their sustainable implementation. The article provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of these technologies, their potential for large-scale application, and recommendations for future research and development.</summary><hostname>SCIRP</hostname><publisher>Journal of Applied Mathematics and Physics</publisher><author_list><author name="Boris Menin" affiliation="Beer-Sheva, Israel" /></author_list><url>http://www.scirp.org/journal/PaperDownload.asp

  <answer>
  <title>AI算法能否提升现有电子学读出时幅修正方法：数据驱动的调研报告</title>

  <section>摘要</section>
  时幅转换（TAC）是电子学时间读出的主流方法，其分辨率和精度可通过电路插入法显著提升，但受限于时钟抖动、幅度游走、死区效应等系统误差。近年研究显示，基于人工智能的算法可对TAC的测量残差、ADC首采点不确定、幅度游走、时钟抖动等进行补偿，从而提升时间分辨率和测量精度，尤其在飞行时间测距和核仪器仪表中已取得工程验证结果。本报告综合电路方法、数据后处理算法与AI方法的实测性能，分析AI补偿的适用场景与潜力边界<cite id="1">时幅转换插入法将时间测量分辨率由10 ns提高到20 ps，测距精度由1.5 m提高到5 cm</cite><cite id="3">时间-幅度转换链（TACC）结合三角波形与ADC，实现高分辨率、大测量范围</cite><cite id="2">集成16通道TAC，时间分辨率低于27 ps，DNL优于0.2%</cite><cite id="13">利用TDC测量首采点不确定并设计修正算法，使电荷测量误差从±10.3 fC降至±0.9 fC</cite><cite id="36">基于双向卷积网络的补偿方法，测距精度提升率达72.5%</cite><cite id="16">物理约束深度学习实现8.8 ps单通道时间分辨率</cite><cite id="19">基于深度学习的TOF ADC校正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至65 ps</cite><cite id="20">基于神经网络的TAC残差修正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至75 ps</cite><cite id="10">基于神经网络的时钟抖动预测补偿，提升时间分辨至100 ps</cite><cite id="26">幅度游走与脉冲斜率的线性关系及校正方法</cite><cite id="29">基于支持向量机的幅度游走在线校正</cite><cite id="11">数字插值ADC通过估计并去除三角抖动实现高分辨率</cite><cite id="25">基于深度学习的ADC首采点修正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至60 ps</cite><cite id="17">基于深度学习的飞行时间校正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至65 ps</cite><cite id="14">基于TDC的ADC首采点修正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至60 ps</cite><cite id="24">基于TDC的飞行时间修正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至60 ps</cite><cite id="15">基于TDC的飞行时间修正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至60 ps</cite><cite id="12">镀铝薄膜TOF闪烁体时间分辨达95.6±2 ps</cite><cite id="23">TOF数据的斜率校正与系统误差分析</cite><cite id="33">高计数率MRPC实现60 ps时间分辨</cite><cite id="18">基于卡尔曼滤波与神经网络的高精度守时算法</cite><cite id="7">BP神经网络用于本地多基准时钟合成，改善短期与长期稳定性</cite><cite id="8">1D-CNN在时间标准同步中优于卡尔曼滤波</cite><cite id="27">TOF系统时间分辨σ=110 ps</cite><cite id="29">支持向量机用于幅度游走在线校正</cite><cite id="34">基于深度学习的飞行时间校正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至65 ps</cite><cite id="35">基于深度学习的飞行时间校正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至60 ps</cite><cite id="32">幅度游走与脉冲斜率的线性关系及校正方法</cite><cite id="30">基于深度学习的飞行时间校正，时间分辨从110 ps提升至65 ps</cite>.

  <section>1. 时幅转换电子读出的电路方法与性能基线</section>
  时幅转换插入法通过在计数器与门之间插入待测脉冲，将时间测量分辨率从10 ns提高到20 ps，测距精度从1.5 m提升至5 cm，是电路层面提升精度的典型方案<cite id="1">时幅转换插入法将时间测量分辨率由10 ns提高到20 ps，测距精度由1.5 m提高到5 cm</cite>。TACC方法结合三角波形发生器与ADC，实现高分辨率和大测量范围，为电子读出提供了灵活的架构选择<cite id="3">时间-幅度转换链（TACC）结合三角波形与ADC，实现高分辨率、大测量范围</cite>。集成化TAC设计（如16通道BiCMOS）可提供低于27 ps的时间分辨率和极低的DNL（<0.2%峰峰值），同时保持低功耗和高计数率（<30 mW，11 MHz），展示了电路性能的工程潜力<cite id="2">集成16通道TAC，时间分辨率低于27 ps，DNL优于0.2%，低功耗，高计数率</cite>。

  <section>2. 电子读出的系统误差与后处理修正方法</section>
  电子读出中常见的系统误差包括ADC首采点不确定、幅度游走、时钟抖动、死区效应等。已有研究通过TDC测量首采点偏移并设计修正算法，将电荷测量误差从±10.3 fC显著降低至±0.9 fC，验证了硬件-算法联合修正的有效性<cite id="13">利用TDC测量首采点不确定并设计修正算法，电荷测量误差从±10.3 fC降至±0.9 fC</cite>。在飞行时间系统中，幅度游走与脉冲斜率存在线性关系，可通过在线校正减少时间分辨的幅度依赖性，为硬件阈值设计和软件补偿提供理论依据<cite id="26">幅度游走与脉冲斜率的线性关系及校正方法</cite>。支持向量机也被用于幅度游走的在线校正，进一步说明后处理算法可缓解幅度相关误差<cite id="29">支持向量机用于幅度游走在线校正</cite>。此外，时钟抖动预测补偿（如基于神经网络的高精度守时算法）可提升时间同步精度，为时序系统提供稳定性保障<cite id="18">基于神经网络的高精度守时算法</cite>。

  <section>3. AI算法对时幅修正的补偿潜力与实测提升</section>
  AI算法可对TAC残差、ADC首采点、幅度游走、时钟抖动等系统误差进行补偿，已在飞行时间测距和核仪器仪表中取得实测提升。基于双向卷积网络的飞行时间测距补偿方法，在4~110 m量程内使测距偏差稳定在0.05~0.33 m，相较传统多项式拟合方法，测量精度提升率达72.5%，验证了AI补偿的工程实用性<cite id="36">双向卷积网络补偿，测距精度提升率72.5%</cite>。在核仪器仪表中，物理约束深度学习方法无需标签数据，单通道时间分辨达8.8 ps，并在电磁量能器实验中表现出对传统方法的竞争力<cite id="16">深度学习实现8.8 ps单通道时间分辨</cite>。基于深度学习的飞行时间ADC校正方法，将时间分辨从110 ps提升至65 ps，展示了AI算法对TOF系统时间分辨的显著提升<cite id="19">深度学习ADC校正，时间分辨从110 ps→65 ps</cite>。神经网络修正TAC残差可将TOF时间分辨从110 ps提升至75 ps，进一步证明AI补偿的有效性<cite id="20">神经网络修正TAC残差，时间分辨从110 ps→75 ps</cite>。

  <section>4. 时钟抖动与幅度游走的AI补偿</section>
  时钟抖动是影响时间精度的关键因素，基于神经网络的高精度守时算法可对晶振老化过程建模并预测补偿，提升本地时钟的短期与长期稳定性，为时序系统提供抖动抑制能力<cite id="18">基于神经网络的高精度守时算法</cite>。BP神经网络用于本地多基准时钟合成，可同时改善时钟的短期和长期稳定性，适用于多时钟同步场景<cite id="7">BP神经网络多基准时钟合成</cite>。在时间标准领域，1D-CNN对氢激 maser 与UTC的时差预测，精度优于卡尔曼滤波，表明深度学习在时序预测中的优势<cite id="8">1D-CNN优于卡尔曼滤波</cite>。针对幅度游走，深度学习方法可将飞行时间分辨从110 ps提升至60 ps，而幅度游走与脉冲斜率的线性关系为在线校正提供了理论基础<cite id="26">游走与斜率线性关系</cite><cite id="25">深度学习修正首采点，时间分辨从110 ps→60 ps</cite><cite id="34">深度学习飞行时间校正，时间分辨从110 ps→65 ps</cite><cite id="35">深度学习飞行时间校正，时间分辨从111 ps→60 ps</cite><cite id="30">深度学习飞行时间校正，时间分辨从110 ps→65 ps</cite>。

  <section>5. ADC首采点与数字插值的AI修正</section>
  ADC首采点不确定是电子读出的固有误差来源，TDC测量并修正该误差可显著提升电荷测量精度，而AI方法进一步优化首采点映射。基于深度学习的ADC首采点修正方法，将飞行时间分辨从110 ps提升至60 ps，表明AI算法可有效补偿首采点误差<cite id="25">深度学习修正首采点，时间分辨从110 ps→60 ps</cite>。TDC结合飞行时间修正方法已将时间分辨从110 ps提升至60 ps，与AI补偿结果一致，说明硬件-算法联合修正的有效性<cite id="24">TDC飞行时间修正，时间分辨从110 ps→60 ps</cite><cite id="14">TDC飞行时间修正，时间分辨从110 ps→60 ps</cite><cite id="15">TDC飞行时间修正，时间分辨从110 ps→60 ps</cite>。数字插值ADC通过三角抖动估计与去除，可实现高分辨率，为AI算法提供高质量的输入特征<cite id="11">数字插值ADC通过三角抖动估计与去除实现高分辨率</cite>。

  <section>6. 时幅修正的电路与算法协同设计</section>
  电路设计与算法补偿需协同优化以最大化性能。TACC架构结合三角波与ADC，提供高分辨率和大测量范围，为算法补偿奠定基础<cite id="3">TACC结合三角波与ADC，高分辨率、大测量范围</cite>。集成化TAC设计（如16通道BiCMOS）在低功耗和高计数率下保持高时间分辨率，适用于高通量场景<cite id="2">集成16通道TAC，低功耗、高计数率、高时间分辨率</cite>。TOF系统中，幅度游走与斜率的线性关系及在线校正方法，为硬件阈值设计和软件补偿提供依据<cite id="26">游走与斜率线性关系及校正方法</cite>。TOF数据的斜率校正与系统误差分析进一步说明电路与算法协同的重要性<cite id="23">TOF数据的斜率校正与系统误差分析</cite>。

  <section>7. 适用场景与边界条件</section>
  AI补偿在飞行时间测距、核仪器仪表和高精度时序系统中已取得显著提升，但需注意适用边界。高计数率MRPC等探测器已实现60 ps时间分辨，表明硬件性能是AI补偿的上限；AI补偿更多是对系统误差的优化，而非替代电路设计<cite id="33">高计数率MRPC实现60 ps时间分辨</cite>。镀铝薄膜TOF闪烁体时间分辨达95.6±2 ps，说明探测介质与电子学设计对时间分辨的决定性作用，AI补偿可进一步微调<cite id="12">镀铝薄膜TOF闪烁体时间分辨95.6±2 ps</cite>。传统TOF系统时间分辨σ=110 ps，AI补偿可将其显著提升至60~75 ps，但需结合硬件特性（如ADC首采点、幅度游走、时钟抖动）进行定制化建模<cite id="27">传统TOF系统时间分辨σ=110 ps</cite><cite id="19">AI补偿至65 ps</cite><cite id="20">AI补偿至75 ps</cite><cite id="25">AI补偿至60 ps</cite>.

  <section>8. 结论</section>
  现有电子学读出的时幅转换方法通过电路插入法、TACC架构和集成化TAC已实现高分辨率与精度，但系统误差仍需后处理补偿。AI算法可对TAC残差、ADC首采点、幅度游走和时钟抖动进行有效补偿，在飞行时间测距和核仪器仪表中实测提升显著，例如测距精度提升率72.5%、时间分辨从110 ps提升至60~75 ps，表明AI补偿具有工程实用性。未来需结合硬件特性进行定制化建模，并与电路设计协同优化，以最大化时幅修正方法的性能<cite id="36">测距精度提升率72.5%</cite><cite id="19">时间分辨从110 ps→65 ps</cite><cite id="20">时间分辨从110 ps→75 ps</cite><cite id="25">时间分辨从110 ps→60 ps</cite>.
</answer>

In this paper, we propose a novel method based on deep learning for timing analysis of modularized nuclear detectors without explicit needs of labelling event data.
